#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

const int MD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> dp(n + 2, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 1)
                ans = (ans + dp[j]) % MD;
            dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + dp[j]) % MD;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
